rec.name: PDP Product Compare Chart (Horizontal Carousel, BuyBox + Full-Width)

what.text: A comparison table on the PDP headed by a question such as "Which product is right for you?". The first column holds row labels (Special feature, Mode of action, Works against, Duration, Application area). Each further column is a product with image, title and attribute values. The current product comes first, followed by up to 5 selectable products. Columns scroll horizontally, with prev/next arrows on desktop. There are two variants: a compact one inside the BuyBox and a full-width one placed anywhere on the PDP outside the BuyBox. Both can sit on the same page and work independently.

why.text: Side-by-side comparison lowers choice overload and helps shoppers pick the right variant or product without leaving the PDP. Spelling out the differences (use case, duration, target pests) reduces the risk of a wrong purchase and returns. It also exposes cross-sell or upsell alternatives at the moment of decision. The question-style heading frames the table as guidance.

how.text: Build the BuyBox version as a block (snippet) in the product info area, e.g. 'CRO | Compare chart'. Build the full-width version as a separate section, with its own unique code and scoped JS/CSS so the two never conflict. Each merchant picks up to 5 products in the theme editor, and attribute rows come from content fields. Use a horizontal scroll container with a sticky label column and prev/next arrow buttons. Hide arrows on mobile (touch swipe only), and show arrows on desktop for the BuyBox version. Hide the empty grey placeholder columns when fewer products are selected.

items: Product selection (up to 5 products besides the current one)
Row labels and per-product attribute values (e.g. Special feature, Mode of action, Works against, Duration, Application area)
Placement: BuyBox block vs. full-width PDP section
Desktop navigation arrows on/off (BuyBox: desktop only; none on mobile)
Auto-hide empty columns when fewer products are chosen

dependencies.text: Shopify OS 2.0 theme with a product template that supports blocks in the BuyBox and sections below it. Attribute content per product (metafields or section block settings) is assumed but not confirmed. No third-party app is mentioned. The Loom setup videos are referenced in the comments but not available here.

items: Scroll/arrow interaction rate on the compare chart
